Resolves #19898

A SharedWorker window that closes during its boot now gives back what it held. #19899's repair ships here too: both are inferred causes of the quarantined film tour, and each is now proven by a unit arm. The first hosted run with both repairs isolated a third cause at hop 4, so both film arms stay quarantined under that reason, and #19919 takes their exit.

- **The tear-out slot (#19898):** `App#registerApp` binds the vessel's slot before it sends `registerAppName`, and `DomEvents#onBeforeUnload` disconnected only the app names the window had heard. A vessel closed in between never disconnected, so its slot stayed bound and every later vessel for that item was refused. A window that knows no app name now sends a window-wide `disconnect`. `onDisconnect` retires the port for it, and `disconnect` releases the binder. `registerApp` registers nothing for a port that has already gone, which covers a registration landing after the window left.
- **The theme counter (#19899):** `insertThemeFiles` lowered `countLoadingThemeFiles` only when a reply resolved. A departed window's reply rejects, so the count stayed up and held every `initVnode` and `updateVdom` in the App worker. The count now drops in `finally`.
- **The diag:** a hop failure prints the slot's binder, whether its port is live, and the theme files in flight. It isolated the third cause on its first hosted run.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms that run the real App worker in a child process over real `MessageChannel`s, red with the repairs reverted) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2). Residual: AC-3, Residual-Owner: #19919.

Both are red with `src/worker/App.mjs`, `src/worker/Base.mjs` and `src/main/DomEvents.mjs` at `origin/dev` (4 failed, 3 controls passed) and green at head (7 passed) |
| AC-3 | Moved to #19919. The first hosted run (job `118662525686`): the viewer-driven arm passed on its first attempt, and its journey birthed and retired every vessel. The autoGates arm stopped once at hop 4 with the slot free and no theme file in flight, then passed on its retry. The shard's 5-minute step timed out with both arms in it. Both entries stay in `BRAIN_QUARANTINES` with that reason |

## Deltas from ticket
- **#19899 ships here.** Its AC-2 arms are in `ThemeFileDeparture.spec.mjs`: a load in flight when its window departs, and one sent after it left, each release the count, and a later update in a live window runs. Its AC-3 moves to #19919 as well. #19899 closes by hand when this merges.
- **The port retires too.** The ticket asked only for a window-wide disconnect. `onDisconnect` would have fired `disconnect` without retiring the port, because `registerApp` had already put the app name on it, and the theme replies pending on that port would then never settle. `onDisconnect` without an `appName` now retires the port.
- **`registerApp` skips all three steps**, not only `admit`. Otherwise `onRegisterApp`'s fallback gives the departed app's name to another window's port with no names yet. The second arm pins it.
- **Not per-window counting.** It would change both vdom gates and the contract documented in `StylingAndTheming.md`. A crash without `beforeunload`, or Playwright's `page.close()`, still leaves a binder and pending replies; #19919's diag lines will show whether that matters.

## Test Evidence
- Full unit suite at `c4bc42d4b9`: 5333 passed, 2 skipped. The new arms pass 70 of 70 with `--repeat-each=10 --workers=12`.
- `E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs`: 23 passed at head. Its resolve test now builds its entry as a literal instead of reading the list's first entry.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: I traced the two edge cases you flagged in the review request across every `disconnect` subscriber in `src/` and `apps/` (`src/ai/Client.mjs:238`, `src/code/LivePreview.mjs:507`, `src/dashboard/Container.mjs:361`, `src/manager/Transaction.mjs:789`, `src/manager/Window.mjs:218`, `apps/portal/view/ViewportController.mjs:166`, `apps/sharedcovid/view/MainContainerController.mjs:323`, `apps/shareddialog/view/MainContainerController.mjs:328`):
  1. **Window-wide `onDisconnect` (`!appName`) and multi-app windows:** Because `DomEvents#onBeforeUnload` (`src/main/DomEvents.mjs:488-494`) emits the nameless `{action: 'disconnect', windowId}` only when `Manager.appNames.length === 0` — and `beforeunload` is a document-wide unload — retiring `sourcePort` unconditionally when `!appName` (`src/worker/Base.mjs:575-579`) is always safe when no app name has reached Main. Moreover, because `App#registerApp` posts `registerAppName` synchronously on the same turn that `App#onConnect` begins `await this.timeout(10)` (`src/worker/App.mjs:629,898-910`), FIFO `MessagePort` ordering guarantees `connect` has not yet fired when `Manager.appNames` is still empty on Main, and retiring `sourcePort` causes the in-flight `onConnect` to exit at `isCurrentPort` (`src/worker/App.mjs:634,644`). The only theoretical multi-app sub-race left is a window hosting two apps where `App1` already received `registerAppName` on Main (`Manager.appNames = ['App1']`) while `App2` called `App#registerApp` in the worker (`sourcePort.appNames = Set {'App1', 'App2'}`) just before `beforeunload`: `onBeforeUnload` would send only `{action: 'disconnect', appName: 'App1', windowId}`, leaving `'App2'` in `sourcePort.appNames` (`size === 1`) so `removePort` would not fire. No multi-window participant in Neo hosts multiple apps in one tear-out vessel, so this is non-blocking, though if multi-app tear-out windows are ever introduced, `onBeforeUnload` could carry a `windowUnload: true` flag to retire the port after the last known `appName`.
  2. **Early return in `App#registerApp` before all three steps (`src/worker/App.mjs:902-904`):** Returning before `onRegisterApp`, `Transaction.admit`, and `sendMessage` is essential — `worker.Base#onRegisterApp` (`src/worker/Base.mjs:630-632`) otherwise falls back from a `null` `sourcePort` to `me.ports.find(item => item.appNames.size === 0)` and would attach the dead window's `appName` to an unrelated booting sibling window's port. Your fourth arm in `MidBootDeparture.spec.mjs:182-201` pins that exact cross-window contamination hazard.

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: In SharedWorker multi-window boot, `App#registerApp` mutates worker-side port and `Transaction` state before `registerAppName` crosses the `MessagePort` to the window's main thread, and `importApp` resolves asynchronously after a port may already have disconnected. Pairing a window-scoped `disconnect` fallback in `DomEvents#onBeforeUnload` with an `isSharedWorker && !port` guard at the top of `App#registerApp` prevents both orphaned tear-out slot bindings and `onRegisterApp`'s empty-port fallback from lending a departed window's `appName` to a concurrently booting sibling window.
